title.narrative: Environmental Literacy Networking (ELN)

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to establish a new quasi-formal quasi-informal network of Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) from Turkey (İstanbul, Çanakkale, Balıkesir, Ankara, İzmir, Mersin, Hatay and Antep) and EU (Italy) in the area of environment and climate change within a three years action.
